question: Where is the famous hill station Ranikhet located?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Uttarakhand__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ranikhet is at an altitude of 1,869 meters above sea level and is within sight of the western peaks of the Himalayas**__.

 __
 
• Ranikhet is a hill station and cantonment town in Almora district in the Indian state of Uttarakhand.
 
• Mankameshwar, Haidakhan Temple, Jhula Devi and Ram Mandir are the revered temples near Ranikhet.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Aravalli Range is a mountain range in Northwestern India, running approximately 670 km in a southwest direction, starting near Delhi, passing through southern Haryana and Rajasthan, and ending in Gujarat.

 
 
• The highest peak is Guru Shikhar at 1,722 meters.
 
 
 
• Malwa Plateau, plateau region in north-central India.
 
 
• It is bounded by the Madhya Bharat Plateau and Bundelkhand Upland to the north, the Vindhya Range to the east and south, and the Gujarat Plains to the west of volcanic origin, the plateau comprises central Madhya Pradesh state and southeastern Rajasthan state.
 
 
 
• Dodda Betta is the highest mountain in the Nilgiri Mountains at 2,637 meters (8,652 feet).
 
 
• There is a reserved forest area around the peak.
 
• It is 9 km from Ooty, on the Ooty-Kotagiri Road in the Nilgiris District of Tamil Nadu, India.
 
 
 
• Mahendragiri is a mountain in the Rayagada subdivision of the district of Gajapati, Odisha, India.
 
 
• It is situated amongst the Eastern Ghats at an elevation of 1,501 meters.
 
 
 
• The Western Ghats
 
 
• The Western Ghat is a region where there is a high number of species and biodiversity.
